name: deliberate
description: Decision and method formats. `deliberate`: evidence harness with independent scouts, verified ledger, rival mechanisms, adversarial contest, silent vote, decision record with a kill criterion. `ldj`: Lightning Decision Jam, AJ&Smart's problem-first workshop, no research needed. `lightning-demos`: the Design Sprint research round that steals one mechanism per example. `five-whys`: Toyota's root-cause chain with an evidence rule. `decision-panel`: a governed multi-agent decision for Paperclip seats with sealed ballots and one Decision Voter.
